main_measure.name: slope of drift-adjusted 168-bar strength on forecast, all grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if t >= 2 (with supporting check), reject if t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean strength on grid bars with forecast > 0 above 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more and the mean strength on forecast > 0 grid bars is above 0.
reading: The coin's normal drift and usual move are the mean and standard deviation of its forward 168-bar returns on the non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 168, ... of each window) pooled over all its windows, grid bars without a full 168-bar forward return inside the window are dropped, and the plan's '300 grid bars with forecast > 0' is treated as a minimum count giving 'not observable' when not reached.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
